name: Gold Vine Hoops
description: Slim hoops hand-wrapped with a delicate vine motif, finished for every-day wear.
care: Keep away from water and perfume. Store in the pouch provided.

name: Pearl Bloom Earrings
description: Hand-set floral studs in soft ivory resin, light enough to forget you're wearing them.
care: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Avoid direct sunlight for long periods.

name: Whisper Drop Earrings
description: Featherlight drops that catch the light with every turn of the head.
care: Remove before sleeping or bathing to preserve the plating.

name: Forest Leaf Necklace
description: A hand-shaped leaf pendant inspired by the Soul Hues emblem, on a fine chain.
care: Store flat to prevent tangling. Keep away from moisture.

name: Emerald Grace Necklace
description: Two hand-strung pearl layers designed to sit beautifully together or apart.
care: Avoid contact with perfume and lotion. Wipe after wear.

name: Sun Coin Pendant
description: A hand-hammered coin pendant with a warm, sun-kissed finish.
care: Keep dry. Polish gently with a soft cloth if it dulls.

name: Floral Charm Bracelet
description: Hand-braided silk thread with a single brass charm, adjustable to fit.
care: Avoid soaking in water. Adjust the slider knot gently.

name: Gold Charm Bangle
description: An open bangle finished by hand, with three softly dangling charms.
care: Store separately to avoid scratching other pieces.

name: Moonstone Cuff
description: A statement cuff set with a hand-polished moonstone centrepiece.
care: Keep the stone dry and away from chemical sprays.

name: Botanical Band Ring
description: A slim band hand-etched with a botanical line pattern.

name: Handmade Beaded Ring
description: Three hand-finished bands designed to be worn together or solo.
care: Store separately to prevent surface scratches.

name: Dainty Bell Anklet
description: A fine chain anklet finished with tiny hand-set bells.
care: Unclasp before sleeping to avoid tangling.

name: Beaded Anklet Duo
description: A hand-strung pair of anklets in earthy glass beads, sold together.
care: Wipe beads dry after wear. Avoid pulling the thread.

name: Pearl Hair Pin Set
description: A set of three hand-finished pins, each topped with a single pearl.
care: Keep dry. Store flat in the pouch provided.
